title: Representation of the People Seventh Amendment Act 1985

sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Seventh Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IX OF 1985
ACT IX OF 1985
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (SEVENTH AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July, 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of
the President on the 15th July, 1985, and is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Act
may be called the Representation of the People (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
